description:
Why Do Onions Make Us Cry? The Sneaky Tear Gas Trick! — You are helping Grandma chop an onion, and suddenly you're weeping buckets of tears! Is the onion actually evil?
Kids science answer for "why do onions make you cry kids science" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

When you slice an onion, broken plant cells mix sulfur compounds into a mild natural gas; your eyes flush it away with cooling tears!

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
